text:
sophie: opened PR #1427 to update the Python SDK snippet in the quickstart and fix a broken link to /auth — small change but CODEOWNERS requires sdk-team + docs-team approvals. https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/1427
ryan: I can do the docs review today, thanks for the ping. will check the example runs locally.
elaine: heads up: GitHub check `ci/docs-preview` is failing on the branch — mkdocs build errors out with `TypeError: sequence item 0: expected str instance, NoneType found`. stacktrace in workflow logs.
jamie: ci-bot shows the preview failed during html build. sometimes re-running the job helps if it's a transient plugin install issue.
docs-bot: CI summary: ci/docs-preview failed — see: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/actions/runs/987654321. Required checks: ci/docs-preview, lint, unit-tests.
sophie: hmm I tweaked mkdocs config to add a custom js file earlier, maybe a stray null in `extra_javascript`. I'll push a tiny fix. if we fix it then the preview should pass and auto-merge can proceed.
ryan: quick question re: auto-merge — our repo has `rules: require 2 approvals` in CODEOWNERS for docs paths. are we still honoring the `auto-merge` label if checks pass but only one approval?
elaine: no, auto-merge is gated by branch protection + GitHub auto-merge app. branch protection enforces the CODEOWNERS-required approvals; auto-merge won't bypass that.
jamie: we discussed a lightweight flow for trivial link/text fixes: label `docs-trivial` + a workflow that can skip one of the approver checks after a single docs review. but it's gated and needs a one-time config change from infra/owners.
sophie: that would help. this change is clearly non-behavioral (link + snippet whitespace). can we get a temporary merge window?
ryan: ops: we could do an "out-of-hours" emergency merge if two approvers aren't available but we must document it. alternatively, add `sdk-team` as a CODEOWNER that auto-approves tiny SDK snippet tweaks — but that requires repo admin change.
elaine: short-term: I pushed a tiny mkdocs fix (removing null entry) to the pr branch, re-ran the docs-preview job using the Actions UI. ci-bot: re-run triggered by @elaine.
ci-bot: ci/docs-preview passed on rerun. preview URL: https://docs-preview.redwood-inference.internal/pr-1427/index.html
ryan: reviewed and left comment around the Python snippet formatting — fixed the import order and removed a stray trailing comma. approved.
sophie: thanks! that's 1/2 approvals. who from sdk-team can give the second? @jamie?
jamie: giving sdk approval now — the code example matches our SDK surface. approved.
sophie: great. does auto-merge kick now or do we need to manually hit merge?
docs-bot: Auto-merge status: enabled, but blocked by branch protection until all required checks are green and required approvals present. All checks green and approvals satisfied -> auto-merge queued.
sophie: sweet, queued. note to infra: can we add a tiny GH action that adds `docs-trivial` label when PR body contains `[doc-only]` and the changes are < 5 files? might reduce manual overhead.
elaine: that rule sounds fine but we need to be careful with automated bypass of CODEOWNERS. file a tiny RFC in #eng with examples and we'll route to security for an exception.
ryan: for future PRs, a checklist snippet to paste into PR template might help: `- [ ] docs-only? (yes/no)`, `- [ ] preview green`, `- [ ] assigned docs reviewer`, `- [ ] sdk owner ack if snippet touched`.
sophie: adding that snippet to the PR template now. after merge I'll drop a follow-up note in #docs about the tiny workflow idea. :thumbsup:
